title: Normalized levelwise principal-cone augmentation to actual integral quotients
statement: For the actual completed integral coefficient ring on the pro-etale site of a scheme T, let P be any K-flat cochain complex and μ the chain endomorphism acting by the actual constant uniformizer. There are maps a_n:Cone(μ^(n+1))→Res_n(P tensor R_n) that are quasi-isomorphisms, commute strictly with the adjacent (μ,1) cone and actual quotient transitions, and whose composites with the unshifted cone inclusions are exactly the specified x↦1 tensor x quotient augmentations. Site and coefficient universes are independent; n=0 denotes the first positive power and individual terms of P need not be flat.

source.place: Tags 0999, 099B and 0A0E; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0941 for the normalized strict Roos model

proof.text: The completed_exact theorem for the actual completed projection gives its short exact principal-quotient sequence. Equality of sheaf morphisms on sections identifies the scalar for the positive uniformizer power and the ring-map projection with those in the regular-quotient cone interface.

Choose the existing normalized cochain change-of-rings model at each quotient. Its object and morphism equations prove equality of its ordinary extension functor with IntegralOnSlice.reduction. Induction on powers and linearity identify the chain scalar with the positive power of the given endomorphism. The normalized regular-quotient augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism on the K-flat complex. Transport it through the scalar equality and the equality of extension functors.

The section normalization of the ordinary coefficient unit, together with the defining generator formula of IntegralOnSlice.augmentation, identifies the transported unit exactly. Thus the transported augmentation in every degree is cone.snd followed by the actual quotient augmentation. The cone summand formulas and naturality of that augmentation prove the adjacent transition equation and the inclusion equation. These calculations also cover the zero complex and the first positive power.

theorem integralPrincipalConeQuotientAugmentation
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (T : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{t})
    (P : IntegralOnSlice.Cx l E T none)
    (_hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := IntegralOnSlice.ring l E T none) P)
    (μ : End P)
    (_hμ : ∀ (q : ℤ) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X q).val.obj U),
      (μ.f q).val.app U x =
        (integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E T).hom.app U
          ((toSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
            ((Functor.const T.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj
              (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{t + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))))).app U
                (ULift.up (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E))) • x) :
    ∃ a : ∀ n : ℕ, CochainComplex.PrincipalCone.level μ n ⟶
        ((IntegralOnSlice.tower l E T none).obj P).obj (op n),
      (∀ n, QuasiIso (a n)) ∧
      (∀ n, CochainComplex.PrincipalCone.step μ n ≫ a n =
        a (n + 1) ≫ integralOperationsTowerStep
          ((IntegralOnSlice.tower l E T none).obj P) n) ∧
      (∀ n, CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr (μ ^ (n + 1)) ≫ a n =
        ((IntegralOnSlice.augmentation l E T none).app P).app (op n))
